methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Growth → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.2x) to $10M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Emelody operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Growth stage, having raised $10M+ to date. The valuation universe comprises ten same-sector peers: one public company (277810.KQ) and nine private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient clustering around Emelody's specific stage and valuation tier to support a robust peer-median approach.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation method here. Using the $10M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $12M. This method assumes forward progression within the Growth stage or toward Series B, though it does not incorporate company-specific operational or market metrics beyond capital history.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single methodological pillar. Key uncertainties include (1) the absence of stage-comparable peers, which limits conviction in relative valuation; (2) the proxy assumption that total raised correlates to current fair value; and (3) lack of data on Emelody's revenue, growth trajectory, or unit economics. A more definitive range would require either comparable transaction data within the robotics subsector or additional company-level operational metrics.
